# One case of place_job, on Maya's rooftop-garden app.
case	Tenki left a job waiting two hours ago; the hour is over, so Tenki takes it again
places	order=own,tenki,github wait=10 connected=tenki usual=6 refused.tenki=1792992800
job	linux	pr	self-hosted,linux,pr
keep	on
queued	0
gone	no
now	1793000000
runner	offline	false	self-hosted,linux,pr
runner	offline	false	self-hosted,linux
expect	tenki	tenki-standard-small-2c-4g	no	offline	own:offline
words	Your machine was offline, so this ran on Tenki.
